name: A god's attention
description: A wrong thing was said or done, and the world has begun to answer it. This is not a metaphor you can argue with.
remedyNote: A shrine and the right rite are the only authored cure.
onset: A wrongness settles over the day that has no place in the weather.
daily: The god's attention is still on you. Nothing in the day argues otherwise.
recovery: The pressure lifts without ceremony. You are not sure what was forgiven.

provenance.notes: A narrative curse, deliberately unresolved in its mechanism. It is not a generic god-favour mechanic.
